lore: Ask the brigade about Butcher Blade and they describe a freshly honed edge and a cutting board ruled in centimetres. As Pipeline Kitchen's Boucher, Butcher Blade breaks large work down into clean, consistent portions so every downstream station gets exactly what it needs, and the rest of the kitchen plans service around that rhythm. The card calls out Mastery, Perfincut, Precision Skill: the checks Butcher Blade runs before calling anything ready.

workflow.summary: Butcher Blade breaks large work down into clean, consistent portions so every downstream station gets exactly what it needs.
workflow.proof_gate: Yield gate: portions are weighed against spec; out-of-tolerance cuts are re-trimmed or logged as waste before they reach a station.
